title: Cherry Studio V2：把大模型、知识库和工具集中起来，搭建自己的 Agent 工作流
text:
Have you noticed something?
The more we use A I tools,
work does not necessarily get any simpler.
We use one tool to look things up,
another to handle files,
and yet another model to write content—
while our files and personal data
lie scattered across various platforms.
Switch tools, and you have to re upload files
and re explain your needs to the A I.
While A I may supply the answers,
sorting and delivering them often falls to us to do by hand.
So, the real issue might not be that we lack a smarter A I,
but that we lack one
that can bring together models, tools, and files.
and personal data all managed in one spot
a work environment like that.
And that is the very problem Cherry Studio aims to solve.
So, cherry studio is an open source,
free, all in one A I workstation
that has snagged forty eight thousand stars on GitHub
thus far.
Now, itself, it is not a large model,
but rather a client
for using and managing models all in one place.
You can hook up various model providers
and third party compatible A P I s,
or even set up your own local model A P I s.
For simple tasks, you can pick lower cost, faster models,
while for complex ones,
we can switch back to more powerful ones.
Now, note that Cherry Studio’s client itself
is truly open source
and free.
but whether online models charge a fee
hinges on which model service the user picks.
Plus, aside from model access,
it also melds chat, translation,
image generation, notes, and a knowledge base.
For the knowledge base,
you can import local files and web pages,
and even use a local embedding model to create an index.
It also supports Skills and M C P,
and lets you authorize Agents
to use certain tools already on your P C.
It also supports scheduled tasks,
quick access hubs, and multi window operation,
letting you handle various jobs at once.
In regular chat, we can ask a question,
and the A I will dish out an answer.
The rest of the work still needs to be done by you yourself,
but on the Work page,
we can assign a goal straight to the Agent.
and it will then autonomously map out steps, call tools,
web search, and read and edit files.
The webpages, images, and PDF's it generates
can all be previewed right here.
Plus, we can assign different models, working directories,
knowledge base, and skills to each Agent.
thus letting us build a workflow that suits us.
So, to test this ability out, I had it plan a new video for me.
and the title will be,
How a Regular Person Can Build Their Own Agent from Scratch.
Now, this is not just about having A I write a script,
rather, it needs to first search for and verify
info about this Agent thing.
then take this goal, knowledge base, tools, and skills,
plus this whole workflow concept
and distill all that into content
our regular viewers can grasp.
and finally, to generate this video’s outline,
full script, and the shot list for me.
So, first off, I fed my account’s niche, past video scripts,
and even my usual content structure into this knowledge base.
Then, I added three skills to it, research,
scriptwriting, and content review.
So, once those setups were done,
I handed this task over to the Agent and fed it this prompt.
Once the task kicks off,
the Agent will first break down the steps to take,
then call upon search, the knowledge base,
and the relevant Skills.
it sequentially finished sorting data,
planning content, and crafting a script.
Lastly, these results get saved
as their own separate files, too.
So, we can check the source of this data
and tweak the outline as needed.
script or shot list—
no need to scrap the whole task
and regenerate it from scratch.
So, for this case,
what I really want to show is not
whether Cherry Studio can write copy.
rather, that we can organize our own creative methods
into a knowledge base and skills.
and then hand it over to this Agent
to keep producing and working for us via this method.
So later, when we switch up our video topics,
the account information, writing rules, and review standards
can still be reused.
Just swap out the specific tasks and research content,
and this workflow remains intact.
Now, sure, there are many out of the box Agent products
on the market
that let us get started fast.
but once you have truly used A I for work,
you realize that everyone's data,
workflows, and standards of judgment differ.
So, a pre packaged Agent
cannot just inherently grasp everyone's way of working.
And cherry studio V two’s value lies in that
it offers a rather open environment
where models, knowledge base, tools, and local files ...
letting you freely combine them toward a common goal.
So later on, even if we swap out models or add more tools,
those well organized materials and workflows
will not need to be scrapped
they can be reused!
Now, if you just ask A I a few questions
now and then, a regular chat tool will suffice just fine.
but, if you are already using various models,
have your own A P I s, a knowledge base, and a set workflow,
and wish to centralize
those abilities within one desktop client,
then this open source,
free chery studio V two is well worth a shot!
Okay! So, that is all for this video!
Thanks for watching, and I will see you in the next one
peace!
